annotations: The owner, 2026-10-17, on the v0.8.0 build's rural roads read at the 50-55 mph state default: "some are given the 35 mph zone despite having a clear sign indicating that it's 25 mph", naming each way. Roads signed 25 mph that OSM carries with no maxspeed. Read at classify time only (routemaker.speed_corrections); a posted maxspeed on the way wins, so a later OSM edit retires its row.

rows.reason: The owner, 2026-10-17: "some are given the 35 mph zone despite having a clear sign indicating that it's 25 mph" and "Wickham Road 62828504". Signed 25 mph; unposted in OSM, so the build read it at the rural default.
